steps.note: Open the prepared closed two-bid event directly on Master QCS.
Confirm both real bidding vendor columns are present before awarding.
Verify Vendor B's bid is shown in the comparison grid.
Open the awarding screen for the prepared closed event.
Allocate the available first line to Vendor B for its full requested quantity.
Assert the available allocation totals 10 × 90 = 900 and accurately reports that only one of two vendors is awarded in this one-line prepared state.
